text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crisis surrounding the "URA Finals" 
had cast a shadow of anxiety far and 
wide...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, you're kidding, right... The URA 
Finals might not even happen?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...? Man, and here I was thinking 
of ways to beat Scarlet in style.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't just let that slide, you know?! 
Ugggh, and here I wanted to settle this on 
the racetrack...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gwooooh, this is such a shocker...!! Even 
though I trained so hard for the URA 
Finals...!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I... regret it as well. I wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to eat... the street stall food 
too............!! So, so 
badly............!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Regarding the cancellation of the 'URA 
Finals.' It seems dissatisfaction is 
spreading among the students as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, hey! Is it true that the "URA 
Finals" are canceled? And after all the 
girls I wanted to cheer for, too...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see... so replacement turf cannot be 
prepared, is that it...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We can't put the runners at risk on a 
torn-up turf track... It's a shame...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I heard about the "URA Finals"... It's 
truly a shame.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It was a race where Meek and I joined 
hands in the truest sense, aiming for 
victory together, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those who look forward to the "URA 
Finals", and those who make it their goal—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This grand stage, which began with 
Chairwoman Akikawa's declaration, had 
somehow come to influence so many people.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But... the issue with the turf is just 
under scrutiny, it hasn't officially been 
cancelled yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
In that case... Trainer <username>, I will not give 
up until the very end.
choice_data_list:
I'll think about whether there's anything 
I can do, too!

I'll see if there's anything I can do, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's put our heads together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We were both wracking our brains trying to 
find a way to hold the "URA Finals", 
but...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Haa... fuh... haa... fuh...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Was that Chairwoman Akikawa just now...? 
Where could she be heading at this hour...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hup... hup...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... What percentage of the course is 
this? About 20%... no, 10%... 5%?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Is it truly impossible after all, for 
me to grow the turf that is needed...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Forbidden! I must not think such 
thoughts! Wooooaaagh!!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hup... hup...! Grow, turf! Run, run, 
Umamusumeee~!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the Chairwoman is trying to 
prepare the track's turf all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, on the large plantation Chairwoman 
Akikawa bought before, growing turf itself 
might actually be possible.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. No matter how you look at it, 
there's no way the Chairwoman could 
maintain the turf covering this vast 
course all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
However... that means if I'm not alone, it 
might actually be possible...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Not alone, but together... If we can ask 
even more people for their help...!
choice_data_list: Our course of action is decided, then!
We've decided what we need to do!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's go right away, Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the next day—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Utter exhaustion...! Pure...! 
Weariness...! However, this is no time to 
be discouraged...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoaaaaa!? What's going on!? 
Wh-What's with this huge crowd!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
"Chairwoman! I heard you're growing turf 
for the 'URA Finals'! Is that true?!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Let us help out too! We've really been 
looking forward to this race!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We also gathered volunteers through 
"Monthly Twinkle's" official page.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: "More help should be gathering soon."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Y-You guys...! Why... are you here...!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Chairwoman! Look over there. They came to 
join us too!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Them...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tch, can Miss Honor Student really handle 
farm work?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Don't you underestimate me! 
Whatever it is, I'll pull it off 
perfectly!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, King! What stellar work! Truly 
first-class! You'd be even more 
first-class if you hauled this dirt over, 
too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's your share of the work! Do 
your job seriously, geez...!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Impressive. You're quite used to 
handling dirt, aren't you, Falcon-san?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's kinda iffy to take as a 
compliment~?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, wait. An agricultural Umadol... 
Could that work!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: E-Even the students... !?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman. Holding the URA Finals has 
long been the heartfelt wish of all us 
students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They called out for help, and so... as 
Student Council President, I gathered 
everyone and arrived here posthaste.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They called out for help, and so... as 
Student Council President, I gathered 
everyone and arrived here posthaste.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Calling out to them? Them...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Calling out to them? The girls...?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"—Chairwoman. On our own initiative, we 
have put out a call for help with the turf 
maintenance."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"And then――this many people! So many came 
together, all wanting to lend a hand to 
the Chairwoman!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username> and Trainer Kiryuin...mini!?
choice_data_list: Everyone's waiting for the URA Finals.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"If we gather this much, we can finish 
laying the turf... We can hold the URA 
Finals...!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Appreciation!! Appreciation...!! I 
gratefully accept everyone's cooperation!
choice_data_list: Let's make the URA Finals a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Of course!! All right, let's get to work!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason everyone lent their support 
surely wasn't just anticipation for the 
URA Finals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because Chairwoman 
Akikawa's passion came through that so 
many people gathered— Such thoughts 
crossed my mind as I planted the turf.
